concepts.description: A structural unit in the system architecture that encapsulates related components, interfaces, types, and functions.
A physical or logical platform that embodies robotic capabilities and interacts with sensors and actuators.
A defined set of values, events, parameters, or functions that enable interaction between system components.
A component responsible for managing or directing system behavior based on inputs and internal logic.
A basic data type predefined by the system, not composed of other types.
A user-defined data type composed of multiple fields, each with its own type.
A callable unit of computation that may take inputs and return outputs.

instances.description: The main module representing the AUV system architecture.
The robotic platform within the AUV system that uses sensor and actuator interfaces.
An interface used by the AUV platform to access sensor data such as depth, heading, and obstacle information.
An interface used by the AUV platform to send commands to actuators; currently empty.
A controller within the AUV system that uses the Inputs interface, likely for operator-initiated commands.
An interface used by controllers like AUV_Operator to receive input events.
A controller implementing the Last Response Engine functionality, using both Inputs and Outputs interfaces.
An interface used by controllers like LRE_Ctrl to emit output events such as velocity or heading adjustments.
An autopilot controller that uses the Outputs interface to control AUV movement.
A primitive type representing natural numbers (non-negative integers).
A primitive type representing integer values.
A primitive type representing sequences of characters.
A primitive type representing true/false logical values.
A primitive type representing real (floating-point) numbers.
A composite type representing a spherical vector with radial, polar, and azimuth components, all of type real.
A composite type representing an obstacle with relative north-south and east-west distances, depth, identifier, and heading as a spherical vector.
An interface (note: likely typo for 'Inputs') defining input events including task termination and requests for various operational modes and values.
A composite type representing close proximity data with horizontal and vertical clearance distances (real) and an identifier (natural number).
A function that computes the Euclidean distance from the AUV to a given obstacle.
A function that computes the horizontal (planar) distance from the AUV to a given obstacle.
A function that computes the vertical (depth-wise) distance from the AUV to a given obstacle.
